title: sum_to(n): add 1 + 2 + ... + n
note: Real compiler output, generated on the Ascend build machine and committed unchanged. -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables only removes .cfi lines to keep the listing short; -fno-pie/-no-pie keep addresses simple. Other gcc versions or targets will print different assembly for the same C. O2-m32.s is the same sum_to function (function.c, copied verbatim from source.c) compiled for 32-bit x86; it is compiled on its own because this machine has no 32-bit C library headers for stdio.h.
